title: Introduce Value Matrix in Self-Attention
full_prompt: Write a complete ManimGL scene named `IntroduceValueMatrix` that visualizes the introduction of the Value Matrix ($W_V$) in the self-attention mechanism of Transformers. The scene should show a word/token embedding vector (representing a word like 'kitty') being multiplied by a weight matrix $W_V$ to produce a new 'Value' vector (representing the message or value of that token). Use a custom matrix-vector multiplication animation where rows of the matrix and elements of the vector are highlighted sequentially using surrounding rectangles, and the resulting vector's elements are computed and updated dynamically. Color-code the matrix entries based on their values (using a blue-to-red or similar gradient for positive/negative values). Ensure smooth transitions, clear text labels for the matrix, input vector, and output value vector, and clean layout positioning.

visual_techniques: Surrounding rectangles highlighting rows and columns
Token/word representation with colored background rectangles

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing custom classes like NumericEmbedding or custom matrix helpers
common_failure_modes.note: The reference code relies heavily on custom 3b1b classes like NumericEmbedding. If porting to standard Manim, these must be simulated using standard DecimalNumbers and Mobject matrices.
Using fix_in_frame() or is_fixed_in_frame in standard ManimCE will cause errors unless using a 3D scene or omitting them.
